title: SolarWinds Orion Platform NCM SCM IPAM SaveUserSetting Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of SolarWinds Orion Platform. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SaveUserSetting endpoint. The issue results from improper control of access to this endpoint. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges from Guest to Administrator.
